_frozen: 2026-11-17, before any test-set prediction was generated. Changes after this date must be logged in research_decisions.md (Protocol change log).

dataset.name: PubMedQA PQA-L (expert-labelled, 1000 items)
dataset.input: abstract sections without the conclusion + question

inference.method: restricted next-token scoring over {yes,no,maybe} surface tokens after the chat template

prompts: src/prompts.py (14 distinct prompts; families para={P0..P4}, fmt={P0,F1..F4}, min={M1..M5}; canonical=P0)

methods.B2: single prompt with best dev macro-F1, argmax
methods.CC: contextual calibration (Zhao et al. 2021) per prompt
methods.ENS: average label probabilities over a prompt set, argmax

stability_metrics: pairwise disagreement / sensitivity (Errica et al. 2025, Eq.1 in review; lower is better)
flip rate: fraction of abstracts whose conclusion differs under >=1 prompt in a set (lower is better)
Fleiss kappa across prompts (higher is better)
accuracy and macro-F1 range across prompts (lower is better)
two-analyst agreement: P(two independent k-prompt ensembles reach the same conclusion) (higher is better)
